paragraphs: Chattermill’s focus on real‑time customer insight mirrors my recent work on NLP pipelines that turn raw feedback into actionable signals for large brands.
I built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph, delivering end‑to‑end retrieval‑augmented generation for complex queries.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, applying a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and MCC evaluation to optimise predictive performance.
